wiki.title: Joe Alexander Jr.
wiki.extract: Joseph H. Alexander Jr. is an American politician who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2018. A member of the Republican party, Alexander has represented the Hillsborough 29th district since 2022 and previously represented the Hillsborough 6th district from 2018 to 2022. He has been the chair of the New Hampshire House of Representatives Housing Committee since its establishment following the 2022 election.
